proof_body:
by
  intro a p q x ha hpq
  rw [mul_assoc]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h2 : (x - p) * (x - q) ≤ 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      push_neg at hn
      have := mul_pos ha hn
      linarith
    rcases mul_nonpos_iff.1 h2 with ⟨h3, h4⟩ | ⟨h3, h4⟩
    · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have := mul_nonneg ha.le (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 h1) (sub_nonneg.2 h2))
    nlinarith
